categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in two main business segments: (1) Customized industry digital transformation solutions for large enterprise groups in power, rail transit, petrochemicals, and aerospace sectors; (2) Standardized and general-purpose software products, primarily represented by the low-code development platform. The company is transitioning from a single-solution provider to a dual-engine driven model combining customized solutions with standard software products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include low-code development platforms (Qingqishou platform), AI technologies (NLP, LLM, CV, OCR, knowledge graphs), and enterprise software development methodologies. Key technologies include visual development, model-driven architecture, code generation engines, and integration with large language models like ChatGLM3. The company employs cloud-native architecture, microservices-based development, and AI-powered intelligent features across its product portfolio.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are large state-owned enterprises and central enterprises, particularly in the power industry (National Grid, Southern Grid, major power generation groups), rail transit (China National Railway Group), petrochemicals, aerospace, and financial sectors. The company also serves local state-owned enterprises and private enterprises. End markets include power system digitalization, rail infrastructure management, industrial manufacturing, and enterprise digital transformation across multiple industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Jinan, Shandong Province. It has established 22 provincial sales teams covering nationwide operations. Key operating regions include East China (54.99% of revenue), North China (31.25% of revenue), and other regions (13.76% of revenue). The company has subsidiaries in major cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Chengdu, Kunming, Xiamen, and Tianjin.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a downstream service provider in the software and information technology services supply chain. It provides software development, implementation, and maintenance services directly to end-user enterprises. The company also develops and sells standardized software products, positioning itself as both a service provider and software product vendor in the digital transformation value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on the dual-engine transformation from customized solutions to standardized software products. R&D priorities include: (1) AI technology integration (LLM, NLP, knowledge graphs) into core products; (2) Low-code platform enhancement and evolution; (3) Industry-specific solutions for power, rail, and petrochemical sectors; (4) Domestic technology substitution and localization; (5) New energy digital management capabilities. The company maintains high R&D investment at 22.13% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple channels: (1) Customized software development and implementation services (85.27% of revenue) - either project-based fixed-price contracts or time-and-materials arrangements; (2) Standardized software product sales and licensing (14.56% of revenue) - including low-code platforms, LIMS, CRM, and other business systems; (3) Software maintenance and operation services; (4) Other services. Revenue is recognized upon project completion and customer acceptance for customized work, and upon delivery for standardized products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the software and information technology services industry, which is a strategic high-tech sector in China. The company positions itself as a leading provider in power industry digitalization with over 20 years of experience and core supplier status to State Grid. In the low-code platform market, the company ranks in the first tier domestically according to Haibi Research Institute. Key competitive advantages include deep industry expertise, established customer relationships with major state-owned enterprises, proprietary low-code technology, and AI integration capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized software services provider with 2023 revenue of 507.87 million yuan, down 19.11% from 627.83 million yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 12.66 million yuan in 2023, down 77.88% from 57.17 million yuan in 2022. The company has total assets of 1.537 billion yuan and shareholders' equity of 1.212 billion yuan as of end-2023. The company is experiencing a transition period with declining profitability due to strategic transformation and increased R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on: (1) Deep industry expertise in power sector with 20+ years of experience and proven track record with major state-owned enterprises; (2) Advanced low-code development platform (Qingqishou) that significantly reduces development time and cost; (3) AI-powered intelligent solutions integrating large language models, NLP, and knowledge graphs into business applications; (4) Comprehensive digital transformation solutions combining customized services with standardized products; (5) Domestic technology substitution capabilities with proven compatibility with Chinese hardware and software infrastructure; (6) Ability to serve diverse customer types from central enterprises to local and private companies.
